book.name: Kolosi
book.title: Babam la omirong Paulo me mai ekelesiap onim Kolosi

content: Mimi teip mila uke, mimi gat le akosarming tavuk ila puvuvui ga tavuk ila muri ira ma teip mim o ubi. Memani, mimi gat la mimaning migana ila kani ituan na panbinim.
Tavuk o marik maranit ga agat ula muru me maun inamaniap la tale naganmeng ira Iesu
Tie, umiaring maranit ira tavuk o marik. Ga na tara la marikming me ai Morowa, maset temamalienming ga mivang temaieng me aun Morowa.

Marikming gat me ai Morowa meba paagaalie ga eba anavang alang me palam meba baispang o ties ang Karisito. Uriro ties, urie la kagoiri tinan, pa ovaikpang ara titot mai inamaniap. Eva, tume bais o uriro ties la kagoiri ang Karisito, are ratmat ga tomaiabu na luguan o arubu.
Marikming me rulam meba puorang it uakap meba ovaiktang urio ties, aret tie la naong Morowa meba ovaiktang.

Tara la mionama ga inamaniap la tale naganmeng ira Iesu, mamiuluan agarip mila mumurum ga makosarming it tavukup mila puvuvum ira ma are la akosarong Karisito ira ma inamaniap na tara la unama na kimanam. Ga terangaming maset ma mirier taraiap ganam meba man baisming o bais ula muru me maun.

Ga na tara la paseiming ga mirie, tie miaramam it tiesiap o ubonuvarap la mime magamelie inamaniap ma mirier taraiap ganam. Me iriro tavuk, eba maset puoming meba mipulang umarik maiong, na tara la mimarikmeng me man muana a paga ba.
Ties lagorang
Tie, eba mialava Tikikas la tunama gare mani togo. Iriro Tikikas, irie papa buang migat ga ume okosar maranit ubi me aun Ila Kani na dalap a ga migan buang o ubi migat ang Ila Kakani.
Asagarung ga muo tie mi meba mialava o nunamap pang la are mani togo ga eba mira uakap, ga me iriro tavuk la eba iat mangangaspang dalap mi.

Asagarung Onesimus ga iat ula ga Tikikas. Iriro Onesimus, irie la ume okosar ubi maranit me aun Ila Kani na dalap a. Irie la ekelesia papa buang, ga napang aime maset. Ga irie la namurit ekelesia kabirana ma inamaniap la mumaio mii tie na lotu Kolosi. Eba mialava ma mirier pagap ganam la betmeng togo.

Tie, miralava a Aristakas la unama na luguan o arubu ga turuo, irie la osagaong “la ula muru” me miun. Ga Marko, talau ang Banabas, irie gat la osagaong “la ula muru” me miun. Osagarung uriro ties me miun, memani na tara la eba betang mi, tie alagiming ga umialeng maset abuo.

Ga Iesu la meiva Iastus, irie gat la ivo “la ula muru” me miun. Kabirana ma teip onim Iudaia, miruot naien ma teip la mime ubi ga turuo meba oagapalie iat inamon ang Morowa. Ga na tara la betieng giginanim ira ruo, mangangasmeng dalap tuo ga toagamelie maset.

Ga Epafras irie gat la osagaong “la ula muru” me miun. Iriro Epafras, irie la namurit ekelesia kabirana ma inamaniap la mumaio mii tie na lotu Kolosi. Ma mirier taraiap la ume marik maranit me ai Morowa meba naganming maranit ga maset mamira mirier agarip am ga makosarming mirier tavukup ganam la naong Morowa maime.
Arit ara ga avaiktung migat gare tiruo: Mitara ubiong ga man miagaalie, ga maagaalie teip ga magaulap onim Laodisia ga Irapolis gat.
Pa Luka ga Demas la osagaliong “la ula muru” me miun. Iriro Luka, la irie umakmager ga mitara napang aime.
Narung meba mialang “la ula muru” rung maun papap ga loup tuam la maionama na taun Laodisia. Ga osagaming gat “la ula muru” rung un ekelesia lou rung Nimfa ga ekelesiap la mime nebola na luguan iang.
Tara la ovasming urio babam, eba osagaming ga ila maun ekelesiap onim Laodisia meba gat ovasmeng. Ga babam la omirtung ga osagarung me ekelesiap onim Laodisia, mirie gat le ovasmeng.
Pa mimi le amilava Arkipus gare ro, “Maset itnamung urio ubi la nuaro ra aun Ila Kakani.”
Turuo Paulo, turuo kan la omirtung urio babam a kilan tuo la osagarung urio “la ula muru” me miun. Agatming me rulam la man tunama ka na luguan o arubu. Ubonuvarap ang Morowa le iot ga mimi.
